name: Burguillos de Toledo (Spain)
description: Yellow field within a green border, charged at the centre with a red castle.
history: The flag was approved by the town council of Burguillos de Toledo on 27 March 2014 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha on 27 May 2015; it is a rectangular cloth one and a half times as long as wide (2:3), yellow, with a green border of heraldic proportions (1:6).
